description: Linda Park calls Howard Liu directly to ask about his RoboRide fleet contact outreach. She wants to know: is there an actual fleet manager or regional operations contact at RoboRide she should be talking to about commercial fleet liability coverage? She frames it as a professional peer conversation — Howard is chasing them for parts supply, she is positioning for the insurance side. She is not asking him to do anything for her; she is asking what he has found so she can be ready when the AutoShield pivot is approved.
expected_outcome: Howard Liu shares what he knows about RoboRide's local fleet operations and whether a commercial insurance conversation is viable. Linda gains a warm contact lead or at minimum a clearer sense of the opportunity size.
